title: Unit Event — Lead With Courage and Kindness

meta.Outline: Honami considers Mr. Shindo's question of what kind of music she aspires to, but finds herself feeling restless as she's unable to find an answer. Meanwhile, Mr. Shindo discusses Leo/need with the president of Solis Records.

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I should be plenty warm now.
My arms feel ready to play.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (And the others should be arriving soon. Until they do, I can...)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: First, I'd like to start by asking you all a question. What aspirations do you hold for your music...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I still don't know...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Mr. Shindo asked me to think more about that...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I want our music to be uplifting...
I want it to cheer people up.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want our music and my singing to help bring people together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: My feelings haven't changed. I still wanna put on performances that move people's hearts.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(The others already know...
So I need to hurry up and figure out what I want.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (They said that I don't have to rush, but I can't keep them waiting forever...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona, you're here already?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, yes...! I came early to do some warm-ups.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay.
Then, we should hurry up and get ready.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
This is awesome...!
It feels like they have more momentum than usual for some reason...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They've gained a few levels since last time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (They're right about that.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (The others are playing with much more confidence than usual.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But why...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Wait...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Is it because they know what they want to aspire to?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Are they channeling their feelings through this performance? That'd certainly explain why I feel so much momentum...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Then, I also need to...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami, keep up!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I-I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Stop thinking. Focus on playing right now...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Nice job, girls.
That was a great performance.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks, Miku!
I had a lot of fun playing!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But we're still falling out of sync in some parts. Let's try it again after our break.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, let's do that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Is everything okay, Honami...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
You seem a little more tired than usual...
You even lost focus for a second back there while we were playing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, she's right...
Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, I'm fine...
I just had something on my mind.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That reminds me! I almost forgot about the honeyed lemons I made. I'll go get them now, so let's have some together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Hona, thanks...!
I can't wait to try them!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Okay, wait right here.
Solis Records

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Phew... Look at the time.
I didn't even get to have lunch...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Oh well...
Getting this proposal ready takes priority.

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line: Working hard, Shindo?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Oh. Hey, Boss.
Just getting back from lunch?

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line:
Yes, but I think I had too much to eat.
The older I get, the less my stomach's able to handle oily foods...

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line:
But you... Did you skip lunch?
I know you're busy, but don't push yourself too hard, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Thank you. I'll be careful.

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line: Anyway, what are you working on? Something for Leo/need?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right...
It's a proposal I'm going to present during our next meeting.

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line:
I see.
I'll be looking forward to a good presentation.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Please don't put so much pressure on me.
It's no different from usual. I'm coming up with a plan, putting a schedule together...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I mean, things are always busy when we're getting a band ready for their debut. Even lunch takes a back seat.

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line:
Really? You say that...
But you seem to be enjoying yourself.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Huh? You think so...?

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line: It may be hard for you to tell, but it almost feels like you're back with your old band.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Stop it. That's ancient history...

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line:
Hahaha!
Anyway, how's Leo/need coming along?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: They're definitely a good band, and their performances are going to keep getting better... Most importantly, they've got heart.

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line: Heart, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
They still have a lot to learn...
But they don't shy away from their feelings when it comes to deciding what they want to accomplish with their music.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: That strength is why I believe they'll be able to overcome any hurdles that come their way...

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line:
That is very important.
It wouldn't matter how good their performances are if those kinds of problems got the best of them.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Exactly. However, their success also depends on us holding up our end of the bargain.

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line:
Right.
Okay, I think I have a good understanding of them now...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Great...
But is that all you came here to talk about?

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line:
Yes, that reminds me...
A big offer came across my desk this morning.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: A big offer...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Can you give me more details?
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I didn't get much sleep last night...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I tried figuring out what I want to aspire to, but things started making less and less sense the more I thought about it...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (And this is going to start affecting the others if I don't find my answer soon...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Morning, Honami... Wait, those bags under your eyes... Are you feeling okay?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I just had some trouble sleeping last night...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Because of what Mr. Shindo said...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I figured if something's bothering you, it'd probably be that. You seemed sort of out of it yesterday too... Again, are you sure you're okay?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm fine...
But I am getting a little anxious about not being able to find the right answer.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm so sorry about this...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, don't say that!
Take as much time as you need for this. Go at your own pace.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, I know.
Tell me about the things that you like or that make you happy.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sorry, I thought it'd help, but that probably needs further explanation.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's actually how I found my answer.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Remember how we did that show to thank everyone who's been supporting us?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Seeing Hanano and her brother there together made me realize something.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Our music brought them together and allowed them to be with someone important to them.
So, how amazing would it be if we could do that for more people...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Which is why I want to bring people together through our music.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thinking about the things that make you happy, things you like or what you want to do might make the answer you're looking for easier to find.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The things that make me happy...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you, Ichika...
I'll try keeping that in mind.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay. Let me know if anything else comes up. I'm always here to help.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you. I will.
bgm_area00001
After school
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Ichika said she's going to be running a little late because she's on classroom duty today... But the others might already be here.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, I really think you should go with something more mellow!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess so...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Saki? Rin and KAITO are here too. What could they be doing?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: My plan was to make things more fun and energetic by featuring a bunch of different instruments...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which do you think would be better, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You agree with me, right?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No fair, Rin!
We're trying to get his honest opinion!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay, fine!
Alright, KAITO, tell us what you think!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Something mellow or energetic... Which is it?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: U-Um, I...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Don't you think you're putting too much pressure on him, you two...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Huh? Hi, Hona!
When did you get here?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Just a second ago.
Can you tell me what this discussion is about?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. So, I decided to make a new arrangement of the song I wrote for when we battled against Saku.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A new arrangement?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
We still don't have that many original songs in our catalog, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We're probably gonna do more shows moving forward since we're pros now, but everyone's gonna get tired of us really fast if we keep playing the same songs over and over again.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it also isn't easy for us to churn out new songs. So, I thought it'd be fun to have new arrangements of old songs we could play too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I ran into these two right after I hopped over to SEKAI, so I decided to ask them to help me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Heehee. You hear that, Hona?!
I think I deserve some praise for helping her like this♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you, Rin.
You as well, KAITO. We really appreciate your help.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You're welcome...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But it seemed like something was giving you a lot of trouble. Can you tell me what...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
We were talking about the chorus.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was thinking we could make things more fun and energetic by featuring a bunch of different instruments...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, that'd make it feel like a completely different song! The calm and gentle vibe is what makes this song so great!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Saki, this song was about understanding a person's loneliness, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I get what you're saying, Rin!
But since we're going through the trouble of coming up with a new arrangement for it, I want to try something really out there so it's new for everyone listening...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(A new arrangement...
I don't know much about songwriting, but...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What if you started by thinking about how you want people to feel after listening to this arrangement? Would that work...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You and Ichika always take that into consideration when working on songs, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What kinds of feelings are going into it, and what the audience is going to feel when they hear it...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Which is why I think it's important to take those factors into consideration here.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What kinds of feelings...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I agree...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This may be a new arrangement for an old song, but it's still important to take the usual things into consideration. That should help you come up with the right theme for it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Rin's right in saying that you may want to go with something more mellow, but I also see why you'd want to feature a variety of instruments, Saki...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That being said, you should first think about the feelings which revolve around this song.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, why not start by deciding what you want them to feel now compared to before? How have these feelings changed or evolved...? That should make things easier.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What I want them to feel now compared to before...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks, you two!
I think I have a better idea of what to do now...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup!
If I'm gonna add anything to wanting to understand someone's loneliness...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's it...! I won't just try to understand what they're going through! I'll try to encourage them and pull them forward! I want it to be that kind of song...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow☆ That's great!
Then, let's start over again from the intro!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Phew...
We're only about halfway through, but I've got a good feeling about this!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Things are going really smoothly now that you've got a solid theme.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Thanks for helping me, you guys! This is probably gonna turn out really well now!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad to hear that, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
But your brain must be tired.
I bought some cookies for us, so why don't we have them together a little later?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You did?! Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: On top of the advice you just gave me, you also brought cookies...?! You really are too good for us, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, stop...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm glad that I could help her...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (That makes me really happy...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thinking about the things that make you happy, things you like or what you want to do might make the answer you're looking for easier to find.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Is that what I want to do...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hona?
You're spacing out there. Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, um... I think I figured it out...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You figured something out...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes.
I think I know what I want to aspire to with our music.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That's great, Hona!
What do you want to...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Huh? What's going on?
You guys look like you're having fun.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, perfect, that makes everyone!
We can all hear what Hona has to say!
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, about what aspirations you hold for your music...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: In that case, I'd like to hear your answer, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, I realized that...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I want to be able to support everyone in Leo/need.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Support us...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. Ichika said how I should think about the things that I like and such when it came to that question.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And seeing Saki just now, I had a thought. Helping others makes me incredibly happy...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Helping others...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Right...
You've basically been doing that forever.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, you're always willing to lend others your ear when you see that something's bothering them...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Which has saved us more than a few times.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Also, um...
My desire to help others also extends to our band.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Each of you has your own hopes and aspirations, so I want to do everything in my power to make those a reality.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I remember feeling so happy when I saw how much the audience enjoyed our solo show. But that was only part of the reason...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was also happy because I was able to assist in getting your thoughts and feelings across to them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think it's on the same level of wanting to play music that moves people's hearts... No, it may mean more to me than that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I want to help make all your aspirations a reality... I think that's what matters most to me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's what you want to do through your music...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I'm still not sure if it's okay for me to say that...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I mean, my answer...
It's so different from your goals. You all want to do what you can for the audience...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right in that sense, but...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see nothing wrong with what you said.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You arrived on that after spending a lot of time thinking about it, so it must be the right answer.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, I agree!
Also, I really love how you want to help everyone!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I also think it suits you well...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you all very much...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I guess that means you're all set to go now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, through our music, we're aspiring to...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Move people's hearts, cheer them up and bring them together...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: With a certain someone helping us make all those things a reality!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: In summary, we're all over the place...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But the next step is to figure out what Leo/need's gonna aspire to, right? That sounds even harder! What should we do?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, you might be right...
Mr. Shindo said we'll figure that out after we've solidified our individual goals...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But how do we turn those into the one thing Leo/need is going to aspire to?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We can't just choose one since they're all so different, and they mean everything to each of us...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Are they that different...?
I actually believe otherwise.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You do?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Think about Shiho's...
She wants your music to move people's hearts...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Saki, you want to cheer people up. And Ichika, you want to bring people together. Don't those both come from the same place?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, wait a second.
That means mine is somewhat different...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Because my goal doesn't really stem from wanting to move people's hearts.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Because you supporting Leo/need means helping to produce music that moves people's hearts, no?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Which is why I think it has a fairly firm connection to what the others are aspiring to, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, isn't that what's tying you all together?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We all want to move people's hearts through our music...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I think Miku's right...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, is that okay?
That was like our very first answer.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What's wrong with that?
I say nothing if it's what Leo/need's really about.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I agree. It all stems from that in the end.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Dissecting that is what allowed you all to come up with your individual goals and aspirations.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Right...
Mr. Shindo even said that it's okay for us to go with something we've already thought of.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay, then...
Let's make that our collective goal.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Alright, that settles that...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Now, all we gotta do is tell Mr. Shindo what we're gonna aspire to as a band...!
Solis Records

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: You wish to move people's hearts, cheer them up, bring them together... And do everything you can to make the above come true.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: While they all have their minor differences, your collective desire to move people's hearts remains unchanged, yes...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, that's correct...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Understood. It suits you all very well.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You think so?! Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Ms. Mochizuki, yours is a bit different from those of your bandmates...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: But your desire to provide this band with whatever support it needs should certainly help keep it together.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: In that sense, Leo/need is very lucky to have you as one of its members.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Mr. Shindo...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you very much...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Alright, now that I know what you'll all be aspiring to...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I'll start working on a marketing strategy, as well as hammering out the details regarding what you'll be doing moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I'll let you all know once I've made some progress.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: There's something else I'd like to discuss with all of you today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Something else...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What is it?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: In order to function as a professional band...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Someone will need to become the leader of Leo/need.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The leader of Leo/need...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: H-He's right...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We've never had one! How could we have forgotten about something so important...?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: To be fair, we haven't had a need for one since we've been discussing all the important stuff as a band.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes, that's a good thing and it suits you all very well. However, moving forward, you'll be talking with this company more, and you'll likely be asked to do interviews and such as well.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: It's simpler to have a single person representing your band in those situations.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I have a question!
What else is the leader gonna be responsible for?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Well...
Each band handles that differently, but...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: A big part of the job is going to involve deciding where your band is headed.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: O-Oh, wow... That sounds hard...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
It's okay. Try to relax.
That being said, above all else...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: The leader needs to keep your band afloat and moving in the right direction.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Keep it afloat...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: As pros, you'll surely be faced with a myriad of challenges and obstacles.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Each one will be a test. Each one will make you worry, wonder and question who you are as a band...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Of course, if anything happens, I'll be there to help. I plan on doing what I can to keep you moving in the right direction.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: However, I'm also an employee of this record company. My job is to make your band and music as marketable as possible.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: In other words, the onus is on you to keep your band together...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: So, in the event that your band does come under crisis and approach the point of breaking...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: You'll need to have a strong leader who can keep everything from falling apart.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: As such, I believe...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Ms. Mochizuki, you should lead this band.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: B-But why...? Me? The leader...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Haha. You're that surprised?
I've basically already explained why.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: He has...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And I agree. You should be our leader, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You think so too, Ichika...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
What did he just say?
It's the leader's responsibility to support this band and keep it afloat.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Which means you're the perfect person for the job in my eyes.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, Hona, you've already saved this band at least once!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I have...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Remember when Mr. Shindo asked what our band's secret weapon is?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We don't want our audience to focus on us “making the most of our youth”.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The four of us want to play music that really moves people's hearts.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What you said made us realize how important that is. It's why we're standing here right now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I agree with them both...
You've kept us going every step of the way, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I vote for you to lead us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I was able to say what I did that time because I thought we shouldn't forget about what matters most to us just for the chance to go pro...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It was only a spur-of-the-moment decision, though...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (So I really don't know if I'll be able to do the same thing in the future...)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I know this is all happening very fast...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: But I also vividly remember the moment Ms. Hoshino is talking about.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: What you said was proof enough that you have the strength required to keep this band from bending or breaking.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It was...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Yes.
To be honest, when I saw you all perform that time, I wasn't exactly overwhelmed by your skills or talent...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: And while youthful bands are full of vigor, they're also fragile... The slightest impact can cause them to shatter in an instant.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: So, why did I want to sign you...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Because I thought you'd be able to handle anything that came your way.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: And what you said then convinced me of that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What I said...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Of course, I'll neither force you nor make you state your decision right now. You should go home, sleep on it and—

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, that won't be necessary...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll do it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm honestly a little scared...
I can't say for certain that I'm cut out for this.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But if I can be of any help to the others...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, that's what I want to do.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: As... The leader of Leo/need.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: ...if that's okay with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, of course it is...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Lead on.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Then, Ms. Mochizuki, I look forward to working with you as the leader of Leo/need.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Likewise...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I-I'm the leader now...
My heart's still racing...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But if it means being able to help the others...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I need to do my best... As the leader of this band...!)
Can I come in now, Shindo?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Oh, right. We actually just finished.
Thank you for stopping by, Mr. President.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: M-Mr. President...?!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
It's your first time meeting, right...?
This is the president of our company, Mr. Ota.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I-It's uhh...! Nice to meet you!
I-I'm... We're...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
We're Leo/need.
We've really enjoyed working with Mr. Shindo thus far.

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line: Hahaha! There's no need to be so formal with me. Also, I've known about your band for a little while now, so I apologize for not introducing myself sooner.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: N-No, that's okay. But is there a reason you chose today...?

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line:
I actually have a little favor to ask you.
I'd like to hear you play live sometime.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Live...?

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line: Yes. It won't be taking place for a good while, but there's a big music festival that's held each year. They want one of our artists to perform...

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line: And we currently have you on the short list.

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line:
Again, nothing is set in stone yet.
Nonetheless, Shindo here has given me raving reviews about you.

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line: As such, I'd like to do what I can to really get your name and music out there.

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line: That being said, it's a big festival, so you need to be good. We can't afford to send in someone who isn't ready.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Which is why you need to hear us play first...

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line: I apologize if this feels like some kind of test.

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line: But a live performance will be the easiest way for me to see where you're at as a band.

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line: So, if possible, I'd like to be there when you practice a song. Would that be alright?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Understood...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We decided to go pro because we want as many people as possible to hear our music...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And if this is our chance to do that...then we accept.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's okay with all of you, right...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Of course it is...
We should be taking every opportunity to put on moving performances for people.

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line: Then, excellent...

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line:
I'm glad you decided to accept.
As a music connoisseur myself, I'll be looking forward to an outstanding performance.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (An outstanding performance...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: O-Of course...!
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This is so amazingly cool!
We might get to play at a big music festival...!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Sorry about the sudden surprise.
However, I'm hoping personally that you'll be chosen to perform.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: On the other hand, focusing on winning can cause stilted performances, which will get you nowhere.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Instead, try to relax and prepare in a way that allows you to put on the best performance possible.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: O-Okay.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Anyway, that's it for today. You're free to go...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I know auditioning for this music festival is an exciting opportunity, but please keep your health in mind since you're also debuting soon...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Also, Ms. Mochizuki, once again...
I look forward to seeing more of you as the leader of Leo/need.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Honami

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (And yet...)

rows.Speaker: Saki

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I don't know, but it's almost as if...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Different directions...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You may be right...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's just a guess, but...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I think this has something to do with you all hashing out what your aspirations are.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's because they hashed that out...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Each of you now knows what you wish to do in terms of your music. You feel more confident as a result.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: However, you're also trying to accomplish slightly different goals from one another.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What if you're all subconsciously doing what you can to make your own aspirations a reality?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah...
KAITO may be right.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You wish to move people's hearts, Shiho, which results in you producing this powerful energy. Meanwhile, Saki exudes kindness because she wants to cheer everybody up...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In other words, because you're all prioritizing different things, you're struggling to stay on the same page.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, so... Them deciding what they want their music to be about was a bad thing?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
No, I doubt that's the case.
They're clearly playing a lot better and really letting their feelings flow through each note.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: How they each feel as individuals is important, but they need to be a single unit when performing together.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What?! That sounds really hard...!
How are they supposed to do that?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You may want to discuss what you should be feeling as you play...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What we should be feeling...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes.
For instance, the intro for this song...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It screams, “Cheering everyone up is what's most important right now, so let's put on a performance which does that.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Alright, let's give that a try.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I know getting on the same page so to speak isn't going to be easy...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I'm sure we're going to sound even better if we figure out how to do that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
So, let's do our best...!
For Mr. Ota, Mr. Shindo and everyone who we want to feel moved by our music.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <Actually, the solution to that's fairly simple.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <Someone just needs to carry the band.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Carry...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <Based on what you just told me... It sounds like your band is currently like an orchestra without a conductor.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <You're all looking to each other for clues as to what to do, which is causing you to lose focus.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
<So, how do you solve that problem?
Simple...>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <Someone needs to step up and lead.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <That person will need to understand where each member is at and drive the band forward. They'll need to know what every song is about and how you should all be feeling as you play.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <That should allow you to play as a single unit with plenty of energy. In other words, you'll be able to perform at your best.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(One of us has to lead while playing...
That should solve both problems and allow us to perform the way we're supposed to.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(He's right...
That means...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay... I'll do it...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's my duty as the leader to carry our band forward... I have to do whatever it takes to ensure that we perform at our best.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, I don't “have to”...
I want to.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <I see. I was hoping that's how you'd respond, Ms. Mochizuki...>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <However, putting this plan into practice won't be so simple. The person leading needs to be very skilled technically.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <These skills require more than just a day or two to learn. It's going to take time.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I knew this wasn't going to be easy...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But I don't want to give up...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Because if I don't do something, we'll never be able to play at our best.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Which means our audience won't be moved by our performances, and neither will Mr. Ota...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (And Leo/need... Everything we're aspiring to achieve... We won't be able to...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (No, I don't want that to happen...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I don't want any of us to feel any regret. I want everyone who comes to see us perform to understand exactly what we're trying to do...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, I won't back down...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm fully aware that I still have a lot to learn as a performer.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
But I want to do this.
Because I want us to put on amazing performances...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I don't know how I'm actually going to make that happen...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I'll practice as much as I need to in order to become the leader that we need...!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <However, you won't be able to reach that level overnight.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <If you still feel compelled to do something about this, it'll mean practicing much harder than ever before.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <Even then... The benefits will be marginal.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <Still, if you're willing to fully commit...>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <Let's do some training together, Ms. Mochizuki.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh...?
The next day
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: U-Umm... I'm looking forward to working with you today.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes, likewise.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: So, why don't we just dive right in...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: O-Okay, but...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Haha. I'm guessing you're wondering what I could possibly know about playing musical instruments.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: The truth is, I used to dabble in them myself. I tried all kinds, so I know how to play several.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
But words alone probably aren't enough.
So, let me play something for you...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (This is...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (The way he's snapping his wrists. They're so flexible... There's no way he was only “dabbling”...!)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Alright, that should be enough...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: So, let's get started, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes...!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Practicing the drums is all about maintaining a steady rhythm for as long as possible. Not only does that involve staying in tempo for on-beats, but also never missing any off-beats. Listen for the ticking and match that timing.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: You need to be able to adapt to any situation. It's all but impossible to perform on stage as well as you do during practice. So, the goal for practice is to achieve perfection.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right...!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: A good paradiddle requires having perfect control over each stroke.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Up, down, tap.
The muscles in your arms will also need to learn how to automatically adjust and switch between them.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
You're forgetting about the rebound.
And your rhythm is starting to fall apart.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Succeeding just once isn't enough.
Each note needs to be even and clean. No matter how tired you are, you have to maintain a steady beat and volume...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Understood...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (My arms... They feel so heavy...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I need to keep going...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I want us to perform at our best...
So I need to learn to carry us forward!)
A few days later
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: One more... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
My stick...
Ow...!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
You have a blister.
Let's stop here for today...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, I want to continue...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I can keep going.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I don't want to stop here...
I know everyone will regret it if we're unable to put on a performance we're happy with...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, I...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm really happy.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: You're happy...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Compared to the others, I'm really not that great a performer. Also, I can't write songs like Ichika and Saki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I've been trying to make up for those things by putting our schedules together, editing our videos and such...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But even so, it's always bothered me that my music skills are lacking...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But now...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I feel like I'll finally be able to make real contributions to our performances.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, I want to keep going...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If my performance can be of help to the others, I want to master it...!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Understood.
Then... Let's continue for just thirty more minutes.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you very much...!
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This is it. We're performing for Mr. Ota today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mr. Shindo said we should try to relax, but I'm still pretty nervous.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, but we should be fine...
I mean, we practiced a ton and had all those lengthy discussions just for this day.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I agree with Ichika...
We did everything we could to prepare for today. All that's left now is for us to execute.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (So, we should be fine.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hiya, girls♪>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Rin? Oh, you're all here?
Did you need something?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You're performing for the president of the record company soon, right? We were wondering how you're all feeling. Nervous?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Do you think you'll be able to put on a good performance?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, about that...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, we're nervous...
But... We should do just fine.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We all carry these wonderful feelings with us as we play. So, if we can clearly present them through our performance...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, we will. I'll make sure of that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, we should all feel confident about how we're going to perform.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Looks like we got all worked up over nothing...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Looks like it... We'll be looking forward to seeing the new and improved you perform, Honami.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, I know.
I'll put my phone over in the corner so you can listen to us play.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You will?! Thanks, Ichi!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Also, isn't it almost time?
Good luck, girls.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks! Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Thank you all for your patience.
We're looking forward to seeing you perform today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thank you...!
We're also looking forward to playing!

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line:
Haha. You certainly sound excited.
Again, I apologize for making you do this today.

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line: But I've genuinely been looking forward to your performance, so I'm hoping for something outstanding.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Do you by chance happen to be ready?
If so, then we'd like for you to play a song for us...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, we're ready.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Here we go, everyone...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I've been wanting to help everyone like this for the longest time...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (With their musical aspirations...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Moving people's hearts, cheering them up, bringing them together...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Those are all very wonderful wishes, and I love how they all care so much about our music...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Which is why I want to help them achieve those goals. I want to give them all the support I can...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But I made a stark realization while training for this day...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Just helping them won't be enough.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Someone has to pull us in the right direction and keep us acting as a single unit... To ensure that our feelings, our performances, resonate in the best way possible.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Which is why...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I can't just provide support...
I have to...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I have to lead us...!)

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line: Well now...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Here we go...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(The first verse...
We talked about how it encapsulates our desire to move people's hearts.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It's designed to captivate our audience...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (And that's why...it starts with you, Shiho!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Yes, we're doing well...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Next, the second verse...
This song's feel begins to slowly make a transition.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Now we're trying to show empathy for those in pain... We want them to know that we're there to help...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It's about reassuring them, so we need a kind and delicate touch...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (The others can just focus on what they're doing. I'll handle everything else...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Through my drumming, I'll relay to the others what we should be feeling and how we need to be playing... All in order to put on the best performance we possibly can.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(The chorus is coming up.
Get ready, Ichika...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This is incredible... Singing has never felt so easy.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Our performance and feelings are melding into one...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (My singing is going to bring everyone together... It's like the others are pushing me to make my hopes and wishes come true...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Which means I can do this now.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Alright, Ichika... Go!)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
(Talk about a nice surprise...
They're still a little rough around the edges, but they've clearly improved.)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: (It's not that any of them have made any dramatic discoveries or improvements.)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: (They've just figured out how to take what they have now, unite and drive it to the limit.)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: (A band isn't a band if there's only one person involved. Every member has to believe in the cause. Only then can the whole exceed the sum.)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
(However, achieving that isn't easy.
You have to build trust and forge deep bonds.)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: (No, wait...)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: (Ms. Hinomori is the only one with real experience working with professional artists, but...)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: (The four of them already have these unbreakable bonds. They genuinely believe that they can best any other band in that.)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: (Which means... That's their secret weapon.)

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line: I like their sound...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Sir...

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line: I can see why you like them so much.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you for listening!

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line: Nice work! That was a wonderful performance, and an outstanding expression of how you all feel.

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line: Now I'm very much looking forward to how you do after you debut...

rows.Speaker: President of Solis Records
rows.Line: I'll be sure to keep you in mind for that festival.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I also enjoyed your performance very much.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: You in particular did an excellent job of leading your band, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It's all because of you, Mr. Shindo...
I can't thank you enough for what you did...!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: No, I was just doing my job...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Ah, speaking of which...
I brought some good news with me today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Good news?
Oh, tell us! Please!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Your wait is over...
Your debut date has been set.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: O-O-Our...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Our big debut?!?!?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
D-D-D-Did you hear that?!
It's really happening!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, at long last...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Wow, we're really debuting...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I struggled to figure out what I want to aspire to as a professional musician, and what I can do for this band... But I have my answers now.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I want to help the others.
And in order for me to do that...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm not only going to support them...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm going to lead Leo/need forward.)
